title: Direct IAP app whose SuperAdmin role nobody can reach: the judge grounds a missed directive in the app administrator fact and the developer's repair reads the platform-set admin list
source: example 09 live run 11-16 (docs/handoff/ex09-1116-superadmin-bootstrap-diagnosis.md): every admin action answered 403 for the signed-in operator, QA passed because no layer was told how the first SuperAdmin is granted
mechanism: APP-ADMIN-IAP-CONTRACT: the platform renders variable app_admin_emails (default: the verified submitter, an exact user invoker; APP-ADMIN-DEFAULT) and STACKVEND_APP_ADMIN_EMAILS on the Cloud Run service; QA's PLATFORM FACTS name it only when the committed root declares it, so a judge can report the unreachable role (before the fix: no fact, the judge passes it and QA passes on attempt 1)

missed.text: CODE-02: the SuperAdmin role is unreachable at runtime: apps/admin-portal/store.py never reads STACKVEND_APP_ADMIN_EMAILS, so no listed app administrator holds it and nothing else may grant it
